source: teacher replay of stored entering states, bf16, both CFG branches in one batch
scope: per prompt x layer x step x branch x head: the cell's pair shares (every query x every key, full 128-dim post-RoPE logits of the model named in `source`) summed over the set's pairs in that cell (union of its Q and K masks). 'all' is the distribution over the entries in which the set has at least one pair; by_layer / by_step / by_branch over those of one layer, step or branch (null where there are none). No mean over cells.
